limitations: Only the degree-nine union of one smooth conic and seven distinct lines over the complex numbers is excluded.
The singularity types must all lie in the list: ordinary nodes, tacnodes, ordinary transverse triples.
No nonexistence claim is made for two or more conics, higher-order singularities, or alternative homological freeness notions.
Historical priority is subject to comparison with any unindexed earlier equivalent incidence theorem.
title: Nonexistence of nearly free nine-degree conic–seven-line arrangements with simple intersections
